item.title: 米9月輸入物価、前年比8.1％上昇 4年超ぶりの大幅な伸び
item.description: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１６日に発表した９月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月輸入物価、前年比8.1％上昇　4年超ぶりの大幅な伸び 10/16 22:39 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチ港で７月撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

[ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１６日に発表した９月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。前年比では８．１％上昇と、２０２２年７月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。中東紛争が続く中、インフレ圧力が高まっていることを改めて示唆した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月比０．８％上昇だった。８月分は当初発表の０．７％上昇から０．５％上昇に下方改定された。関税は輸入物価指数から除かれている。

９月の輸入燃料価格は前月比４．８％上昇し、８月の０．２％下落から反発した。輸入食品価格は横ばい。８月は０．６％下落していた。

輸入資本財価格は０．９％上昇。投資ブームを背景としたコンピューター、周辺機器、半導体の価格上昇に押し上げられた。

自動車を除く輸入消費財の価格は０．４％上昇した。耐久消費財が０．７％上昇したことがけん引した。輸入自動車・部品・エンジンの価格は０．３％上昇した。

食品とエネルギーを除くコア輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、伸びは前月から横ばいとなった。前年比では６．２％上昇した。

中国からの輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、２１年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前年比では３．１％上昇。日本、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、メキシコ、カナダからの輸入価格も上昇した。

輸入航空旅客運賃は１２．６％急騰した。７月と８月は下落していた。

今週発表された消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）はいずれも大幅な伸びを示しており、エコノミストの間ではインフレがエネルギー部門を超えて波及しているとの見方が強まっている。米国・イラン戦争が長期化する中、サプライチェーン（供給網）は混乱し、原油価格は高止まりしている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「米国人はあらゆる面でインフレの脅威に直面しており、ほんの数カ月前までは安かった同じ商品に少し多く払わなければならない状況にある」と指摘。「２５年１月に第２次トランプ政権の経済政策が始動する前には、輸入物価のインフレは見られなかったが、今年はいたるところでインフレが起きている」と述べた。

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The artificial intelligence boom is setting off a global race for money, forcing central bankers to contemplate a future in which interest rates stay higher and governments need to tighten their belts after an era of largesse. From silicon chips and data centres to power grids and telecoms networks, governments and companies are pouring money into projects tied directly or indirectly to AI, adding fuel to the global economy and pushing up borrowing costs. Central bankers from the world's largest economies gathering in Bangkok said the boom was also creating fresh inflation pressures and financial risks, because the investment is arriving long before the productivity gains AI promises. "If you're a central banker...you've got to recognise this as a shock," Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok. "It's obviously hitting the demand side of the economy before it's going to hit the supply side."

Warsh, who said the US was benefiting from a broadening "surge of investment", warned the transition could be "very bumpy" as investors, companies and policymakers grappled with a technology whose ultimate winners remain unclear. Several of his colleagues from the G20 group of large economies also in the Thai capital said it would only take a slight reassessment of the rosy earnings prospects underpinning AI investments to cause profound market ructions, as a selloff in Asian tech stocks showed this week. STARS BEHIND THE CLOUDS The debate marks a striking shift from the years following the 2008 financial crisis, when policymakers worried about excess global savings and inflation that was persistently too low. Now central bankers increasingly see the opposite problem: too much demand for capital. "There is a global fight for money," ECB policymaker Martins Kazaks told Reuters. "Investment in AI is one of the key factors driving up the cost of money." That pressure is being amplified by governments from the United States to Japan and Germany borrowing heavily for defence, industrial policy and energy projects. For central bankers, the implication is that the level of interest rates needed to keep economies on an even keel, known as R-star, may be rising. "The problem at the moment in calculating the R-star is that the stars are covered by the clouds, and the clouds are so thick," South African Reserve Bank Governor Lesetja Kganyago said. "We know that R-star is higher, but we do not know how high." A higher neutral rate means the same level of interest rate is less restrictive than previously thought. "Maybe rates, on average, will be that little bit higher," said Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill. The Bank of Japan has already cited AI-related demand as a factor behind its recent rate increases, arguing that investment-driven price pressures have become broader and more persistent. Economists expect the Bank of England to raise rates at its next meeting on November 5. The ECB and Fed raised rates in September, and markets have priced in another move by them both in December.  NO MORE CHEAP MONEY The prospect of structurally higher borrowing costs poses a challenge for governments that built up large debts during years when interest rates hovered near zero. Sovereign bond yields have risen across the world, and in recent weeks some have reached levels not seen since before the global financial crisis. The euro zone, and notably debt-laden France, was seen as particularly exposed. Much of the AI-driven investment surge is taking place in the United States and, to a lesser extent, Japan and other parts of Asia, with ASML and Siemens among the few clear European winners. Meanwhile, the bloc faces higher energy costs from wars in Iran and Ukraine, compounding inflation pressures and squeezing public finances. "There are particular circumstances that lead to some countries being more affected, France being a case in point," ECB President Christine Lagarde said at a CNN event in Bangkok. "And for that one, the primary and first solution lies at home in France. And it has to do with fiscal policies."

(Additional reporting by David Milliken and David Lawder; Editing by John Mair and)

Source: Reuters

IMF chief urges cooperation on AI and war risks, as US hails economic momentum

Kristalina Georgieva, Managing Director of IMF, speaks to Ceda Ogada, Secretary of IMF at the Annual Meetings Plenary for the IMF/World Bank 2026 Annual Meetings at Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok, Thailand, October 16, 2026. REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The head of the IMF on Friday appealed to global leaders to cooperate in the face of multiple economic risks, including rapid advances in AI and a prolonged war in the Middle East, as Washington hailed what it sees as US-led economic momentum. Their contrasting views echoed throughout this year's annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok, as finance officials and central bankers from around the world took stock of a global economy rocked by high inflation and rising interest rates that have kept growth sluggish and increased inequality. The IMF on Tuesday slightly raised its global growth forecast to 3.1 per cent in 2026, well below the historical average, as it flagged significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential ending of the AI investment boom, growing debt levels and the ongoing Middle East conflict. Absent the US-Israeli-led war against Iran and Tehran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz that triggered a massive global energy shock, the IMF has said it would have expected AI to have fueled much stronger growth.

On Friday, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said the sheer speed of technological change added to the long list of challenges, including disruptions to the global trading system, high food and energy prices and lingering wars, all of which threatened to widen the gulf between advanced economies and the world's poor. Bond markets, she said, were clearly sensing the risks, with US, German and Japanese 10-year sovereign yields reaching their highest levels in decades. "The need of the hour is for urgent and practical international cooperation," Georgieva, the first IMF chief from an emerging market economy, said at a plenary session on Friday. She told a subsequent panel that she spent sleepless nights worrying about how to regulate AI and ensure that poorer countries weren't left behind by its breakneck-speed development. US Treasury Under Secretary Erin Browne, in a call with reporters, pushed back against those warnings, hailing record highs on the US stock market, strong US economic output and improvements in Japan's economy. "The IMF needs to take a more balanced approach to assessing the global economic outlook," she said, adding: "The global economy has demonstrated significant resilience with strong US growth helping to support broader economic and financial stability." She said that the Fund should give equal consideration to "opportunities for positive economic shocks, particularly those driven by American innovation and super intelligence, energy abundance, and productivity-enhancing reforms." US President Donald Trump's policies on tax, trade, energy and deregulation were paving the way for stronger investment, higher productivity and durable economic growth, she said. AI JITTERS HIT STOCKS Emerging market stocks have been volatile in recent weeks, roiled by expectations of higher US interest rates that have sent borrowing costs sharply higher. Major markets have also been hit by the growing concerns over the AI investment cycle. South Korean shares posted their biggest weekly fall in 18 years as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom, while Japan's stock market lost 5.4 per cent over the week. Eli Remolona, governor of the Philippines' Bangko Sentral ng Pilipanas, said in an IMF panel discussion earlier in the week that he was concerned Asia had not learned the lessons of its destructive financial crisis in the late 1990s. Before the Asian financial crisis broke out in 1997, economies drew huge capital inflows that prompted the World Bank to describe it as the "East Asian miracle," Remolona said. "Investment poured into Asia, and then you had the crisis because it wasn't really a miracle. I think we have to remind ourselves about that. We have to guard against that kind of crisis," he said on Wednesday. "We have not really been making a lot of effort looking at that kind of crisis." Illustrating the vulnerability to sudden shifts, Indonesian stocks fell 11.6 per cent on Friday, their steepest one-day fall in 28 years, after global index provider MSCI said the Indonesian market was no longer worthy of "emerging market" status. Officials at the IMF and World Bank this week said they are seeing elevated demand for grant and loan programs. IMF strategy chief Christian Mummsen said the IMF's low-interest lending to low-income countries had quadrupled since the COVID pandemic, and demand was expected to remain strong. About 60 per cent of the IMF's financing since COVID had gone to low-income countries, he said.  Developing countries are increasingly outspoken about their concerns. Barbados this week joined a group of countries calling for the creation of an international panel to address inequality, citing geopolitical tensions, climate change and rapid technological advances that could further divide wealthy and poorer nations.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Panzani, Cerealis in talks to create €1.8 billion European food group
item.description: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday. The proposed deal reflects a broader push for consolidation in Europe's food sector as manufacturers seek greater scale to cope with rising costs, strengthen their bargaining power with retailers and expand across regional markets. The deal would create a European food group with about €1 billion in annual revenue and nearly 1,800 employees, the companies said Panzani, which is controlled by private equity firm CVC, generated €620 million of revenue in 2025. Cerealis, controlled by its founding families and Belgian investment company Sofina (SOF.BR) , reported revenue of €400 million Panzani and Cerealis would remain headquartered in Lyon and Porto respectively and retain operational autonomy The merged group would be owned by Cerealis' existing shareholders, including the Moreira da Silva and Silva Domingues families and Sofina, alongside CVC Capital Partners, which would keep a minority stake Cerealis' Executive Vice Chairman Pedro Moreira da Silva would lead the combined group, while Panzani CEO Albert Mathieu would oversee Panzani and its Central European operations. Cerealis CEO Paula Meireles would manage its Iberian and international private-label business ($1 = 0.8887 euros)

item.title: 基調物価2％の判断、10月会合でしっかり議論 経済は見通し通り＝日銀総裁
item.description:
Takahiko Wada Takaya Yamaguchi
［１６日 ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
基調物価2％の判断、10月会合でしっかり議論　経済は見通し通り＝日銀総裁 10/16 21:50 配信

2026年9月18日、日本銀行の政策決定会合終了後に記者会見する植田和男総裁。ロイター／キム・ギョンフン

Takahiko Wada　Takaya Yamaguchi

［１６日　ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。

９月の決定会合以降の経済のデータは「おおむね見通し通りに動いている」とし、今回の出張で様々な当局者と意見交換をしたが、自身の見立てと「矛盾するような重要な情報がもたらされたとは考えていない」と話した。

主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議などへの出席のため訪問したタイ・バンコクで会見した。

植田総裁は基調物価が２％に迫る中、「（基調物価が）これ以上上がることは容認できず、その定着を政策の大きな目標にする」と説明した。植田総裁は９月の決定会合後の会見で「政策の局面が変化した」と言及していた。

インフレ圧力について、中東情勢と人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の高まりを特に注視してきたが、日銀と各国当局者の間で見解に「大きな食い違いはないとの印象を持った」と述べた。ＡＩ関連の需要動向について、日銀よりも「やや心持ちしっかりしているとみている当局者が少し多いと思った」とも話した。日銀は１０月会合で「経済・物価情勢の展望」（展望リポート）を議論する。

植田総裁は、基調物価が２％に近づき、金融環境が緩和的な中で、経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて「政策金利を引き上げて緩和度合いを調整していく」と述べた。政策調整のタイミングやペースについては、中東情勢やＡＩ関連の需要動向、為替相場の動きを見ながら、見通しの確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくと改めて説明した。

中立金利については「はっきりとこの辺にあると申し上げられるような材料があるわけではない」とし、これまでの利上げの累積的な効果を見極めながら判断していきたいと述べた。

８月３１日から９月１日に米国・アッシュビルでＧ２０や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の財務相・中銀総裁会議が開かれた際、植田総裁はベセント米財務長官と会談した。この日の会見では、アッシュビルでの会談以降は「コミュニケーションは特に取っていない」と述べた。ウォーシュ米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）議長とは「様々な意見交換をした」としたが、具体的な内容は明らかにしなかった。

植田総裁とともに会見に臨んだ三村淳財務官は、足もとの金融市場の状況について「今に限らず、いつにあっても常に金融市場の状況をしっかりと注視し、決しておかしなリスクが顕在化しないようにしっかりと取り組む」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に 最終更新: 10/16(金) 21:59 ロイター

item.description: AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems. An Ahold spokes

Supermarket operator Ahold's websites, app remain offline 5 days after cyber incident

FILE PHOTO: A customer is seen inside Albert Heijn shop, operated by Ahold Delhaize, the Dutch-Belgian supermarket operator, in Eindhoven, Netherlands, January 23, 2019. REUTERS/Eva Plevier/File Photo

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems.  An Ahold spokesperson said the parent company cannot comment about the situation at its individual chains. Its US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, are collectively one of the largest food retailers in the United States. Physical stores remain open.  Ahold's Albert Heijn chain, the Netherlands' largest, has been gradually recovering from the shutdown that began October 11, disrupting its distribution centres and leading to empty produce shelves. Albert Heijn does not expect online delivery to resume before Sunday. The Netherlands' Justice Minister David van Weel called on the company on Friday to file a criminal complaint over the incident, which Ahold has avoided describing as a hack, saying in a statement that no "customer, associate and partner data was taken".

"I understand that in the heat of the moment, a company like this is concerned with preventing damage to its systems and is not immediately looking outward," the minister told Dutch press agency ANP. "I think that we're in calmer waters now and the time has come to take this step." The Ahold spokesperson said the company could not respond to the politician's remarks and pointed to its most recent statement on October 14, in which it said the company was working with relevant internal teams and external cybersecurity experts and engaging with the appropriate authorities and other stakeholders as necessary. That statement said that because Ahold's investigation is ongoing, it could not share details about what happened in order not to undermine its own security or interfere with its response.

item.title: ロシア無人機、ウクライナ各地攻撃 3人死亡
item.description: [キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局によると、１６日未明に各地でロシアの無人機（ドローン）攻撃があり、少なくとも３人が死亡した。商業施設２カ所が攻撃を受けたほか、北西部では電力網への攻撃で約３７万人が停電の影響を受けた。

ハルキウ州知事によると、東部ハルキウ市の３地区への攻撃で２人が死亡、１２人が負傷した。同氏は当初、死者を３人としていた。

ポーランドと国境を接する北西部ヴォルィーニ 州では、食品加工施設への攻撃で１人が死亡、８人が負傷した。

当局によると、前線に近い北部スムイ市と、ヴォルィーニ州に隣接するリウネ州でも、それぞれ少なくとも１カ所の商業施設が攻撃を受けた。

Tokyo, Oct 16 : The next phase of Japanese corporate reform took center stage at the Sohn Conference in Tokyo, as hedge fund managers highlighted investment opportunities ranging from a financial conglomerate's capital allocation strategy to an X-ray scattering firm's AI solutions. At the inaugural Sohn Conference in Japan, which invited 14 funds to pitch their top investment ideas, more than half of the investors favored the theme of corporate reform. Daisuke Nakayama, a portfolio manager at Hong Kong-headquartered Polymer Capital, picked Orix Corporation, a financial services firm, saying the change in management marks "a big turning point" for the company's transformation into a global investment firm. "The new leadership has a greater focus on capital allocation and ROE," Nakayama said, adding the firm is now using overseas capital, including from Qatar Investment Authority, to bid for companies.

The number of activist campaigns in Japan hit a record last year, according to brokerage Jefferies, after years of pressure from regulators and the Tokyo Stock Exchange on companies to improve shareholder returns and invest in growth.  BEYOND DIVIDENDS AND BUYBACKS Fund managers said that the next chapter is not just about companies increasing dividends and buybacks but also about focusing on those deploying capital to expand businesses and drive long-term growth. One example is Rigaku, an X-ray equipment supplier pivoting to semiconductor metrology, measuring and inspecting chips.  New York-based Indus Capital Partners said it had invested in the company and had engaged with the firm to sell a stake to a US semiconductor firm to drive revenue.  As semiconductor companies are going into vertical structures to scale, X-ray is needed to detect defects deeper in the 3D chips, said Byron Gill, managing partner at Indus. Rigaku might be one of the few companies that "has the key to unlocking scale for the semiconductor industry in the middle of a super cycle", he added, forecasting a 100 per cent rise in its valuation by 2029. REFORM THEME DOMINATES The corporate reform theme still has a long way to run, market participants said.  "Japan changes slowly, but once the change starts, it does not reverse," said Naohide Une, partner and CEO at Investment Lab, a former senior managing director at Japan Post Bank. He picked Japanese chemical company Ube Corporation for its corporate reform efforts. In a separate Q&A session, Seth Fischer, founder of activist Oasis Management, said his fund may substantially increase its stake in Japanese electric motor maker Nidec. AI AS A BACK-OFFICE TAILWIND AI was another key investment theme.  Investment firms Ruane Cunniff and Japan Catalyst picked software companies Money Forward and OBIC Business Consultants, respectively.  They argued that back-office software operators are AI winners rather than losers, as clients require accuracy. And these businesses are helping Japan overcome labor tightness, they said.

item.title: Why is the battle for Yemen's Taiz so important?
item.description: The city of Taiz is rapidly emerging as the most important battlefront in Yemen's reignited civil war, pitting the Iran-allied Houthis against the internationally recognised government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition.
item.dc:creator: Angus Mcdowall
item.content:encoded: The city of Taiz is rapidly emerging as the most important battlefront in Yemen's [USN:L6N45S0PX TEXT:"reignited civil war"], pitting the Iran-allied [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"Houthis"] against the internationally recognised government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition. Houthi forces have [USN:L1N45Z0S1 TEXT:"encircled Taiz"] in recent weeks by cutting its main road south to Aden, causing widespread displacement and worsening a humanitarian crisis. Here's what you need to know: WHY IS TAIZ SO IMPORTANT? Any Houthi victory in Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, would mark one of the biggest turning points in the country's long civil war, which resumed this summer after a four-year truce. Taiz city has an estimated population of almost 600,000, said Katja Juric, Aden-based head of programmes for the International Organization for Migration (IOM). Government sources said 80,000 had fled in the latest fighting. Taiz has been on the frontline between the Houthis and the government since the first days of the conflict that started in early 2015 and has long been seen as a bastion of opposition to the Iran-allied group. It is the last major urban stronghold of anti-Houthi forces in the southern highland area of Yemen: the rugged hills above both Aden, where the internationally recognised government is based, and the flat coastal plain around the [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb"] Strait. A Houthi takeover of Taiz would make it much harder for government forces to maintain their counterattack around Bab el-Mandeb and keep the Houthis at arm's length from Aden. It would also mean a resounding symbolic defeat for the government and the military coalition of Saudi-backed Yemeni forces fighting the Houthis. WHAT'S THE MILITARY SITUATION AROUND TAIZ? For years the city has sat at the tip of a government salient stretching north into Houthi territory. The Houthis held areas to the north, east and west of Taiz, while government forces had the city and its immediate surroundings including Jebel Sabar, the high mountain rising above it to the south. As fighting in Yemen resumed in recent weeks, the Houthis began making advances to cut off Taiz by seizing territory to the south of Jebel Sabar along the road to Aden, which snakes about 200 km (125 miles) through rugged hills where fighting is slow and difficult. Sections of the road are now under Houthi control, including at the towns of al-Turbah and Mudiriyat al-Misrakh, leaving Taiz encircled since early October, with the Houthis sometimes shelling government positions in and around the city. Government forces, backed by airstrikes from the Saudi-led coalition, are trying to drive the Houthis back from their recent gains and reopen the road, but were still losing ground around Taiz rather than recapturing territory in mid-October. WHY IS TAIZ A STRONGHOLD OF OPPOSITION TO THE HOUTHIS? Taiz had a long history of difficult ties with rulers from north Yemen and was a hotbed of the 2011 Arab Spring uprisings that toppled veteran former president Ali Abdullah Saleh. While the Houthis adhere to the Zaydi school of Shi'ite Islam, Taiz is predominantly Sunni Muslim. Saleh and the Houthis joined forces to seize the capital, Sanaa, in 2014, derailing a political transition that arose out of the Arab Spring and had led to a proposal for a federal, democratic state. In early 2015, army units loyal to Saleh seized positions in the city, leading to big protests there followed by armed clashes. Protesters accused Saleh and the Houthis of mounting a coup d'etat. Months of fierce fighting in and around the city followed, with the Houthis and Saleh's army units battling local fighters and army brigades from Yemen's now fragmented military that backed the government. Taiz citizens endured shelling, sniper fire and terrible shortages in a long siege before government forces eventually drove the Houthis and their allies from the city and re-established a land route to Aden. The fighting in the city lasted throughout 2015 and parts of 2016, and the siege ran for long stretches until 2017. WHAT IS THE HUMANITARIAN SITUATION IN TAIZ? The latest fighting has displaced at least 121,000 in Taiz province, according to the IOM, though many of these are from rural areas outside the city. Inside Taiz, residents have told Reuters about the shortages they now face of basic items and the huge increase in prices they see in the city markets since the Houthis cut the road to Aden. Aid agencies have reported widespread shortages of fuel, food, medicines and clean water. Wheat flour stocks in the city are nearly exhausted, the World Food Programme said in mid-October. The situation risks worsening existing health problems. The UN children's agency UNICEF recently found that one in three of the children it screened in Yemen was malnourished. Cholera, dengue and malaria are all present in Yemen too. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? Government forces backed by Saudi airstrikes are still trying to take back territory to reopen the road, but there is no guarantee they will succeed. The Houthis, who have [USN:L1N46209G TEXT:"upped their attacks"] on Saudi targets while showing themselves [USN:L6N4580DE TEXT:"better armed"] and organised than in earlier phases of the war, are meanwhile trying to cement their siege of Taiz and move closer towards the city. That might lead to a prolonged siege of the kind that Taiz experienced in the earlier phase of the war. It's also possible the Houthis might try to take the city. Local opposition means resistance could be fierce and any such attempt could cause a long, bloody battle.

item.title: 欧州、債務持続性へ成長加速と赤字削減を＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Jan Strupczewski
［バンコク １６日 ロイター］ - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日、欧州各国が公的債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州、債務持続性へ成長加速と赤字削減を＝ＩＭＦ 10/16 20:59 配信

国際通貨基金（IMF）のロゴ、ワシントンの本部で2024年撮影 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/File Photo

Jan Strupczewski

［バンコク　１６日　ロイター］ - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日、欧州各国が公的債務を持続可能な水準に維持するには成長を加速させるか、借り入れを減らす必要があるとし、「何もしないという選択肢はない」と警告した。

ＩＭＦは１３日、ユーロ圏の経済成長率について、４月時点と同じく２０２６年が１．１％、２７年は１．２％と予想した。インフレ率は、２６年が３．１％、２７年が２．８％、２８年が２．２％になると予測した。

ＩＭＦは「債務の持続可能性を保つには、欧州諸国の約４分の３で、成長を高めて歳出圧力を緩和する構造改革と、中期的に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比で平均約３．５％に相当する財政赤字削減策を組み合わせる必要がある」と指摘した。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）全加盟国が欧州委員会と合意しなければならない「中期財政・構造計画」で予定されている財政再建規模はＧＤＰ比で平均約２％にとどまり、一部の国で必要とされる水準を下回っているという。

「スタッフの基本予測は、大半の国で財政再建が計画を下回ることを示しており、想定されている再建規模でさえ達成が困難となる恐れがある」と指摘。

「欧州諸国の約４分の１は、公的債務を持続可能にするためにＧＤＰ比で５％超の財政再建が必要となる。これは過去に実行可能と証明された水準を上回っており、政府活動の範囲を見直し、不足分を補うために民間部門の役割を拡大する以外に選択肢はない」と分析した。

欧州委が５月に発表した予測によると、ＥＵ全体の債務の対ＧＤＰ比率は、２５年末時点の８２．８％から２６年に８４．２％、２７年末までには８５．３％へ上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏の比率も２５年の８８．７％から２６年に９０．２％に上昇し、２７年には９１．２％に達すると予測されている。

ＩＭＦ欧州局長のマテウシュ・シュチュレク氏はロイターに対し、「高齢化、国防費増額、エネルギー移行など、欧州の大半の国が直面している長期的な歳出課題を勘案すると、政策変更がなければ欧州の平均的な経済において公的債務は大幅に増加し、現在の水準の最大２倍に達する可能性がある」と述べ、中欧の高成長国の一部では、この債務拡大のペースがさらに速くなる可能性があるとした。

「持続可能性の定義が（債務の）増大を止めて安定化させられるかどうかであるなら、財政面での対応と再建が不可欠だ」とし、「より早く動く方が常に対処費用は少なくて済む。着手が遅れるほど調整は難しくなる」と語った。

ＩＭＦは欧州の成長加速に向けた最大の障害は低水準の生産性だと指摘し、各国政府に対してＥＵ域内市場の障壁を取り除き、技術革新（イノベーション）や事業拡大への投資を行うよう求めた。

「一定の改革に向けた取り組みが進められているものの、未完成のＥＵ単一市場と各国の障壁が、企業の事業調整や規模拡大、より大きな市場へのアクセスを困難にしている」とした。

また、化石燃料から再生可能エネルギーへの移行を継続し、重要鉱物を含む世界的なサプライチェーン（供給網）の多様化を進めるよう呼びかけた。これらは全てＥＵが既に取り組んでいる政策方針となる。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：欧州熱波、マクロ経済面からの市場注目ポイント コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:59 ロイター

item.title: 仏借り入れコスト上昇、長期化なら財政健全化圧力高まる＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Jan Strupczewski
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のシュチュレク欧州局長はフ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏借り入れコスト上昇、長期化なら財政健全化圧力高まる＝ＩＭＦ 10/16 20:55 配信

シュチュレクＩＭＦ欧州局長、１４日撮影 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

Jan Strupczewski

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のシュチュレク欧州局長はフランスの借り入れコストが上がっていることについて、短期的には対処できるとの見方を示した。ただ上昇が続けば２０２７年予算だけでなく、信頼性のある中期的な財政健全化計画の策定を求める圧力が強まると指摘した。

シュチュレク氏はバンコクで開かれているＩＭＦ年次総会の合間にロイターの取材に応じた。現時点では仏国債市場はまだ秩序立った動きを保っているとの認識を示した。

「（市場には）流動性があり、（国債の）償還期間もかなり長く、投資家層も多様だ。銀行の流動性が高いことも支えになっている。このため短期的な債務リスクには十分対応できる」と語った。

一方、「利回りの高止まりが長引けば、財政とコスト抑制への圧力が強まる。財政の不均衡是正が急務であることを改めて認識させる。まずは２７年予算から着手すべきで、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の財政ルールに沿って遅滞なく承認される必要がある」と述べた。

フランスは２６年の財政赤字を国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５．４％と見込む。２７年は５．０％への引き下げを目標としている。ＥＵの法令を順守するには、２９年までに赤字をＧＤＰ比３％未満に抑える必要がある。

シュチュレク氏は「それは確かに必要だ。市場の動きは、われわれにもフランスの政策当局者にも、その必要性を改めて認識させている」とし「市場のシグナルには政策を変える力がある。過去に何度も見てきた。ある意味では、債券市場から現実を突き付けられることで、財政調整のあり方が変わり、調整が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:55 ロイター

item.title: Strategy faces MSCI ouster under new rules, billions in passive holdings at risk
item.description: Michael Saylor's Strategy faces potential removal from MSCI's global equity indexes under new rules adopted on Thursday, threatening billions of dollars in passive investment in the bitcoin buyer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR.O) faces potential removal from MSCI's global equity indexes under new rules adopted on Thursday, threatening billions of dollars in passive investment in the bitcoin buyer. Shares of Strategy, the world's biggest corporate bitcoin holder and a constituent of the MSCI USA and MSCI World indexes, fell 4.2% on Friday. MSCI said on Thursday non-operating companies will be ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes from the close of November 30, as part of its November index review. It will publish the final list of affected companies on November 11. The decision follows a review MSCI [USN:L1N3X907U TEXT:"began "]a year ago, when it proposed excluding digital asset treasury companies on the grounds that they resemble investment funds, which are already barred from its indexes. MSCI [USN:L4N3Y80MJ TEXT:"deferred "]that plan in January and opened a broader review on all non-operating companies. MSCI defines non-operating companies as investment funds and business development companies, and other companies whose finances make them look like one. Strategy and Japan's Metaplanet (3350.T) are on MSCI's list of potential deletions. SharpLink (SBET.O) and several other crypto treasury companies are on a watchlist for possible removal. The changes are aimed at expanding MSCI’s exclusions for passive investment vehicles, with companies required to meet financial tests on their operating assets to remain eligible. Index inclusion matters to companies such as Strategy because passive funds and other investors tracking benchmarks are required to hold their shares. Strategy did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The company warned last year that an exclusion would result in $2.8 billion of its stock being [USN:L6N3XP0XN TEXT:"liquidated "]and would "chill" the industry. Strategy, which pioneered the model of raising money through stock and debt sales to buy bitcoin, had a market value of about $64.3 billion on Friday. Its shares were down 4.8% in 2026.

item.title: トヨタ、30年までに全車種をＳＤＶに 年1000万台の新車に独自ソフト搭載
item.description: [東京 １６日 ロイター] - トヨタ自動車は、２０３０年までに世界で販売する全５０車種を「ソフトウエア定義車両（Ｓ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トヨタ、30年までに全車種をＳＤＶに　年1000万台の新車に独自ソフト搭載 10/16 20:20 配信

トヨタ自動車の「ＲＡＶ４」。２０２５年５月、東京で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Manami Yamada）

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - トヨタ自動車は、２０３０年までに世界で販売する全５０車種を「ソフトウエア定義車両（ＳＤＶ）」にする。独自のソフトウェアプラットフォーム（基盤）「Ａｒｅｎｅ（アリーン）」を新車に順次搭載する。ＳＤＶで先行する中国や米国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーを追撃し、年間１０００万台規模の新車販売に加え、売った後もソフトの更新などを通じて課金するビジネスモデルを強化する。

同社広報によると、中嶋裕樹副社長が先週、アリーンの導入計画をベルギーのブリュッセルで投資家に説明。３５年にはトヨタ車以外にも展開し、提携先など他社の車両にアリーンを供給する考えも明らかにしたという。

トヨタは２５年に発売したスポーツ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）「ＲＡＶ４」で初めてアリーンを導入し、今後販売する新車に順次展開する方針を示唆していた。

ＳＤＶは、スマートフォンのように購入後も無線通信を通じてソフトを更新し、先進運転支援技術やエンタテイメントなど車の性能や機能を向上させる車で、米テスラや中国勢が先行している。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：サウジを揺さぶるフーシ派、攻撃力向上の背景は アングル：米国の「軽油ショック」、消費者の身の回りで着実に進行 コラム：トヨタ自動車、ＨＶ技術活用で再び成長軌道へ 焦点：トヨタの中国合弁2社に再編機運、市場縮小と競争激化で転換点 焦点：トヨタ社長、3年でなぜ交代　インフレが変えた時代の潮流 最終更新: 10/16(金) 20:20 ロイター

item.title: TSX rises as oil stocks gain on Brent touching $110 a barrel
item.description: Canada's main stock index gained on Friday, boosted by oil stocks, while investors assessed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index gained on Friday, boosted by oil stocks, while investors assessed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) gained 0.11% to 36,176.55, touching its highest level since September 4. The index gained 1.44% in the week. Energy stocks (.SPTTEN) rose 2.8%. Brent touched $110 a barrel for the first time since May on worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further tighten supplies. South of the border, Wall Street ended sharply lower, with CoreWeave, Broadcom and other AI-related technology stocks under renewed pressure. In Canada, technology stocks <.SPTTTK> fell 3.5%, dragged down by a 5% fall in Shopify (SHOP.TO) and 7.7% decline in BlackBerry (BB.TO) . "It's (AI trade) probably affecting the TSX to a significantly lesser extent than it's affecting some of the US indices... there's a pretty big disparity between tech and everything else at the moment," said Josh Sheluk, CIO at Verecan Capital Management. "The TSX offers a pretty interesting diversifying investment relative to global stocks because it is a lot more heavily allocated and weighted towards not only energy but materials as well," Sheluk said. Macklem said Canada [USN:SPN46200A TEXT:"has not raised interest rates"] yet but the longer elevated energy prices go on "the harder that gets". The BoC is not expected to raise interest rates at its next monetary policy decision announcement on October 28, but money markets are pricing in a rate hike of 25 basis points in December, according to data compiled by LSEG. Data on the day showed that Canadian home sales [USN:L6N46119G TEXT:"extended their decline"] in September, after a drop in August, as higher mortgage rates and expectations of a rate hike weighed on demand.

FAST

BERLIN, Oct 16 : Germany is set to announce a cooperation agreement with US chipmaker Nvidia next week to expand the use of artificial intelligence in German industry, government sources said on Friday, adding the plan will involve partners beyond Nvidia and be a major contribution to industrial AI. Business daily Handelsblatt, which first reported on the plan, said the deal would support physical AI tools for training robots and self-driving vehicles and help develop powerful AI models for industrial use.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Wall Street tumbles as worries about AI trade and high oil prices weigh
item.description: Wall Street tumbled on Friday, with CoreWeave, Broadcom and other AI-related technology stocks under renewed pressure, while a jump in oil prices spooked traders heading into the weekend.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Wall Street tumbled on Friday, with CoreWeave, Broadcom and other AI-related technology stocks under renewed pressure, while a jump in oil prices spooked traders heading into the weekend. The Nasdaq was on track for a loss of over 4% for the week, hammered by concerns that debt-laden AI infrastructure companies may not turn profits in time to repay debts, particularly with borrowing costs expected to rise. [USN:L6N4620IB TEXT:"Nvidia-backed"] CoreWeave (CRWV.O) slumped 12%, bringing its loss over the past five sessions to about 25%. The data center operator's bonds also sold off sharply this week, pushing yields above 15%. Broadcom (AVGO.O) fell 3.6%, and the PHLX chip index (.SOX) sank 2.5%, on track for its eighth straight day of declines. Investors on Friday were also watching oil prices jump more than 3% due to Middle East supply worries. "There is some fear in the market," said Rob Haworth, senior investment strategist at U.S. Bank Wealth Management in Seattle. "High oil prices, in particular, tend to weigh on the price/earnings multiple of stocks, and so I think you have investors looking to be cautious into the weekend rather than take more risk." Adding to concerns around AI financing, some current Anthropic investors and prospective investors [USN:L6N4611DN TEXT:"are weighing a lower valuation"] for the company in its upcoming IPO, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The S&P 500 was down 1.22% at 7,649.71 points. The Nasdaq declined 2.19% to 26,128.13 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.55% at 51,891.77 points. Six of the 11 S&P 500 sector indexes declined, led lower by communication services (.SPLRCL) , down 2.52%, followed by a 2.38% loss in information technology (.SPLRCT) . The S&P 500 was set for its steepest weekly loss since January, and the Nasdaq was heading for its sharpest weekly fall since June. Third-quarter earnings season shifts into gear next week with reports from Tesla (TSLA.O) , Meta Platforms (META.O) and Procter & Gamble (PG.N) . Analysts on average see quarterly earnings surging over 30%, driven by AI-related megacaps, according to LSEG data. While the S&P 500 remains up about 12% in 2026, most of that gain has come from AI-related tech stocks, and the index’s median component has climbed only about 6%, year to date. About 185 S&P 500 stocks have lost ground in 2026. Hotter-than-expected consumer and producer inflation reports this week showed price pressures were extending beyond energy commodities. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on Friday [USN:L6N462084 TEXT:"voiced optimism"] about US economic strength and surprise about how well global economies have been "hanging in there" during a lingering energy shock and tighter monetary policy to fight inflation. Markets increasingly expect the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged this month. Barclays [USN:FWN4622T4 TEXT:"now expects"] 25-basis-point hikes each in December and January. Tesla (TSLA.O) dropped 2.5% after the electric-vehicle maker unveiled a [USN:L1N46200L TEXT:"redesigned Roadster"], powered by rocket-style thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX. Netflix (NFLX.O) [USN:L4N46128P TEXT:"appointed"] former Disney executive Peter Rice as chief content officer on Thursday. Its shares were down 2.9%. Declining stocks outnumbered rising ones within the S&P 500 (.AD.SPX) by a 1.3-to-one ratio. The S&P 500 posted 19 new highs and one new low; the Nasdaq recorded 49 new highs and 263 new lows. (This story has been corrected to fix the year to 2026 from 2025, in paragraph 13.)

item.title: Huracán Trudy se debilita frente a costas del Pacífico mexicano
item.description: El huracán Trudy se debilitó el viernes en aguas del Pacífico mexicano, pero podría recobrar fuerzas en las próximas horas, advirtieron meteorólogos, mientras continuaba acercándose a la costa occidental del país, que apenas comienza a recuperarse de una serie de ciclones que han dejado inundaciones y daños en semanas recientes.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré
item.content:encoded: El huracán Trudy se debilitó el viernes en aguas del Pacífico mexicano, pero podría recobrar fuerzas en las próximas horas, advirtieron meteorólogos, mientras continuaba acercándose a la costa occidental del país, que apenas comienza a recuperarse de una serie de ciclones que han dejado inundaciones y daños en semanas recientes. A las 14.00 hora local (2000 GMT), el ciclón se ubicaba a unos 365 kilómetros al suroeste de la ciudad portuaria Acapulco, en el estado Guerrero, y sus vientos máximos sostenidos se habían reducido a 140 kilómetros por hora (km/h), mientras avanzaba hacia el norte-noroeste a 7 km/h, según datos del Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (NHC, por su sigla en inglés). "Mientras navegaba por las cálidas y tranquilas aguas del Pacífico oriental, Trudy [USN:L6N46119M TEXT:"se fortaleció rápidamente"] el jueves (pero) perdió algo de intensidad de viento durante el viernes", dijo AccuWeather, una compañía estadounidense de servicios comerciales de pronóstico del tiempo. "Trudy seguirá siendo un huracán peligroso mientras se desplaza cerca de la costa centro-occidental de México durante este fin de semana, con fuertes vientos, mar agitado y lluvias torrenciales", agregó. Más temprano, Trudy llegó a ser un huracán de categoría 3 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson y se esperaba que se intensifique a uno de categoría 4. Un ciclón de ese nivel puede soplar vientos máximos sostenidos de hasta 250 km/h y causar daños generalizados en estructuras protectoras, desplome de tejados en edificios pequeños, erosión de bancales y playas e inundaciones en terrenos interiores. Si bien no se prevé que toque tierra, el ciclón, de categoría 1, descargará lluvias torrenciales y dejará fuertes ráfagas de viento y oleaje peligroso en la franja costera que va desde el conocido destino turístico Acapulco hasta Puerto Vallarta, pasando por los dos mayores puertos del país: Manzanillo y Lázaro Cárdenas, puerta de entrada principal para mercancías provenientes de Asia. La agencia de protección civil de México pidió a los residentes que comenzaran a prepararse para la llegada de la tormenta asegurando puertas y ventanas, y retirando objetos que pudieran ser arrastrados por los fuertes vientos. En Acapulco, una ciudad de unos 700,000 habitantes, los pescadores guardaron sus embarcaciones luego que autoridades cerraron algunos puertos pesqueros y turísticos a la navegación de embarcaciones menores. En las últimas semanas, la costa del Pacífico mexicano ha sido golpeada por los huracanes [USN:L6N45L0YK TEXT:"Polo"] y [USN:L8N45V0SM TEXT:"Simon"], y la tormenta Rachel. A causa de las lluvias y las inundaciones, ocho personas perdieron la vida en la ciudad costera de Ensenada, en el estado Baja California. Simon sigue activo, aunque como tormenta tropical, frente a la costa centroccidental del país.

item.title: イスラエル人入植者、ヨルダン川西岸で住民襲撃 取材中の米写真記者負傷
item.description:
Pesha Magid Ali Sawafta
[アブファラ（ヨルダン川西岸） １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Pesha Magid　Ali Sawafta

[アブファラ（ヨルダン川西岸）　１６日　ロイター] - イスラエルが入植計画を進める占領地ヨルダン川西岸で１６日、覆面をしたイスラエル人入植者数十人がオリーブを収穫していた住民を襲撃し、取材中だった米紙ワシントン・ポストの米国人写真記者を含む少なくとも２人が負傷した。

パレスチナの医療関係者によると、負傷して病院に搬送されたのは米国人フォトジャーナリストのハイディ・レビン氏。襲撃時の映像には、レビン氏が舗装されていない道路で顔を手で覆いながら横たわり、周囲を少なくとも３人の入植者が取り囲む様子が映っている。

レビン氏は搬送先の病院で取材に応じ、地面に突き倒され、繰り返し蹴られたと述べ、「防弾チョッキとヘルメットを着けていなければ、今ここにいなかったかもしれない」と襲撃時の恐怖を語った。

ワシントン・ポスト紙のマット・マレー編集主幹は声明で「レビン氏はジャーナリストであることを明確に示す標章を身に着けていた。職務を遂行していたジャーナリストに対する今回の不当な襲撃に強い憤りを感じている」とし、「当局に対し、この件について徹底した調査を実施し、適切な対応を取るよう求める」とした。

イスラエル軍は、現地に展開した兵士と国境警察が警告射撃を行い、ある時点で部隊が脅威と判断した人物に向けて発砲したとする声明を発表。「住民同士の対立をあおる行為はこの地域の安全を損なう」とし、「罪のない民間人に対する攻撃や暴力は重大で、容認できない」とした。

現場を目撃したロイター記者によると、オリーブの実を摘むためにアブファラの村人が畑に集まっていたところ、入植者約８０人が畑を見下ろす丘から下りてきた。一部は投石器を使い、村人たちに向けて石を放ったという。襲撃のさなか、イスラエル軍のジープ少なくとも２台が土ぼこりを上げながら現場一帯を走行。軍の到着後も襲撃は続き、イスラエル兵はジープを避けて逃げたパレスチナ人に向けて催涙ガスを発射した。

現場では銃声聞こえ、ロイターの写真記者は武装した入植者少なくとも１人が銃を撃つのを目撃した。

アブファラでの襲撃に先立ち、１６日朝にはトゥルムスアヤ村周辺でも同様の襲撃があった。入植者らはオリーブを収穫していた農家の集団を襲い、車３台に火を付けた。

イスラエルの入植活動を監視する人権団体「イェシュ・ディン」によると、占領下のヨルダン川西岸では、イスラエル人入植者によるパレスチナ人への暴力が急増している。オリーブ収穫が始まった頃にあたる９月２７日以降、少なくとも１７０件の襲撃が起きた。

ネタニヤフ首相は暴力を批判しているが、取り締まりに向けた措置はほとんど講じていない。

item.title: Russian attacks kill eight in Ukraine, cut power to over a million
item.description: Russian attacks killed at least eight people and injured 60 across Ukraine on Friday, hit two shopping centres and cut power to more than 1 million people after strikes on the energy grid, officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian attacks killed at least eight people and injured 60 across Ukraine on Friday, hit two shopping centres and cut power to more than 1 million people after strikes on the energy grid, officials said. A 71-year-old woman and a 58-year-old man died and 12 more people were wounded in attacks on three districts of the eastern city of Kharkiv, Governor Oleh Syniehubov said. He had earlier put the death toll at three. Further Russian strikes through the evening injured nine people, officials said. Attacks in the frontline city of Kramatorsk in Donetsk Region killed two people and two more were killed in southeastern Dnipropetrovsk Region. Ukraine's energy ministry said its repair crews had returned power to over 1 million people who had lost it as a result of Russian attacks on Friday. It was not clear how many were still without power. In the northwestern region of Volyn, which borders Poland, a drone strike on a food-processing facility killed one person and wounded eight others, according to Governor Roman Romaniuk. He said 370,000 people were temporarily without power in the morning, although 100,000 of them got supply back later on. The blackout could last for at least 24 hours in Volyn's regional capital, Lutsk, Mayor Andriy Razumovskyi said on Facebook. Romaniuk said that drone attacks continued throughout the day, striking a customs terminal and torching about 10 trucks in the town of Kovel, which sits on a major trunk road from Kyiv to Poland. Other attacks hit at least two shopping centres — one in the northern city of Sumy, which lies close to the front line, and one in the neighbouring region of Rivne, officials said — the latest in a spate of Russian assaults on malls and markets. Pictures from emergency services in Sumy showed blood spattered across the floor and shots of the centre's damaged entrance. One person was killed and seven wounded by drones that hit a major shopping centre and other sites in Rivne, regional governor Oleksandr Koval said. Ukraine's energy ministry said large parts of the city of Rivne and the surrounding area were without power after attacks on energy infrastructure there.

item.title: ペトロチャイナ、取引部門の26年利益が過去最高に 中東情勢の影響回避
item.description:
Chen Aizhu
[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国石油天然気（ペトロチャイナ）で、原油などの取引を手...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ペトロチャイナ、取引部門の26年利益が過去最高に　中東情勢の影響回避 10/16 19:33 配信

ペトロチャイナのロゴ、メディア向け視察ツアーで6月撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

Chen Aizhu

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国石油天然気（ペトロチャイナ）で、原油などの取引を手掛けるトレーディング部門の２０２６年の利益が過去最高を更新する見通しであることが、複数の関係者の話で分かった。イラン紛争によって中東産原油の売買形態が一変し、需給が逼迫する中、中国国外の製油所の利幅が大幅に拡大している。

アジア最大の石油・天然ガス生産会社で中国第２位の石油精製会社であるペトロチャイナは、大規模な生産・供給ポートフォリオと広範な精製・小売りネットワークを生かして利益を上げ、戦争に伴う供給混乱の影響を回避できている。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、ペトロチャイナのトレーディング部門、中国石油国際事業（ＰＣＩ）の２６年粗利益は２００億元（３０億ドル）を超え過去最高になる見込み。

同部門の幹部によると、通常、ＰＣＩ部門利益の半分以上を稼ぎ出す原油部門の利益が１０月初旬までに、２５年通年の２倍以上に達したほか、石油製品部門や天然ガス部門も好調に推移している。

同社は決算でトレーディング部門利益の内訳を開示していない。８月に発表した上半期グループ純利益は約１４６億５０００万ドルだった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：サウジを揺さぶるフーシ派、攻撃力向上の背景は アングル：米国の「軽油ショック」、消費者の身の回りで着実に進行 アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 アングル：ＥＵの自動車現地調達ルール案、中国勢は先回りで足場固め アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え 最終更新: 10/16(金) 19:33 ロイター

item.title: Hurricane Trudy weakens but may regain strength off Mexican coast
item.description: Hurricane Trudy weakened on Friday but could regain strength in the coming hours, meteorologists warned, as the storm approached Mexico's western coast, packing winds of up to 140 km per hour (85 mph).
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré, Aida Pelaez-fernandez
item.content:encoded: Hurricane Trudy weakened on Friday but could regain strength in the coming hours, meteorologists warned, as the storm approached Mexico's western coast, packing winds of up to 140 km per hour (85 mph). Further strengthening is forecast before Trudy nears Jalisco and Colima states in central-western Mexico late on Saturday as a life-threatening major hurricane, Mexican authorities and the US-based National Hurricane Center said. The center of Trudy will approach the coast of southwestern and west-central Mexico on Saturday and pass near the coast Saturday night into Sunday, the NHC said in its latest advisory. "Trudy will remain a dangerous hurricane as it moves near Mexico's central-western coast this weekend, bringing strong winds, rough seas, and torrential rain," said private forecaster AccuWeather. Earlier, Trudy had reached Category 3 and was expected to intensify to a Category 4 hurricane. Any change in its path closer to shore will increase the severity of its impact, the head of Mexico's weather agency, Fabian Vazquez, said at a press conference. "Everyone in this region needs to be very careful and stay alert over the weekend," he added. Mexico's civil protection agency asked residents to prepare by securing doors and windows, and removing objects that could be thrown around by the strong winds. In the coastal resort city of Acapulco, fishermen pulled their boats ashore after authorities closed some fishing and tourist ports to small vessels. The storm is expected to produce up to 15 inches (38 cm) of rain in the states of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco, increasing the risk of life-threatening flooding and landslides, according to the NHC. Mexico's Pacific coast has already been battered in recent weeks by storms that left several dead and caused severe flooding. Tropical Storm Simon continues to weaken farther northwest offshore, after [USN:L1N45Y0H6 TEXT:"dropping heavy rain"] along the coast earlier as a hurricane. Last week, Tropical Storm Rachel hit the Baja California peninsula, damaging some 1,500 homes.

item.title: Wall St Week Ahead As AI rally wobbles, stock market's spotlight turns to earnings
item.description: Stumbles in the market-leading AI trade are set to test investor confidence in the rally in the coming week as Wall Street focuses on quarterly results due from key players including Meta Platforms .
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf
item.content:encoded: Stumbles in the market-leading AI trade are set to test investor confidence in the rally in the coming week as Wall Street focuses on quarterly results due from key players including Meta Platforms (META.O) . AI-linked stocks, central to [USN:L6N45R12W TEXT:"the bull market"] that just marked its fourth anniversary, [USN:L6N460140 TEXT:"struggled in recent days"], with sharp declines in shares of semiconductor companies and tech hardware firms such as Dell Technologies (DELL.N) . Meta, among the hyperscalers spending massively to build AI data centers, highlights the upcoming week of quarterly reports, along with semiconductor firms Lam Research (LRCX.O) and Texas Instruments (TXN.O) and Elon Musk -led companies SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) . "It certainly feels like the narrative in the market is a little bit jittery," said Garrett Melson, portfolio strategist with Natixis Investment Managers Solutions. "Clearly there's a lot of uncertainty around where AI stands right now." Worries rippled through markets over risks tied to [USN:L6N461185 TEXT:"the financing of the AI build-out boom"], which has lifted profits for a wide swath of companies and boosted economic growth. Investors were watching [USN:L4N461208 TEXT:"developments with CoreWeave"] (CRWV.O) , an AI cloud company with about $50 billion in debt. This week, its shares tumbled. In other recent signs of caution, strategists at Deutsche Bank and RBC Capital Markets separately pulled back on their recommendations of the tech sector. On October 9, Deutsche Bank strategists said the rotation into tech had "run far and the risk-reward no longer looks favorable in the near term." Dragged down by the swoon in heavyweight tech and AI stocks, the S&P 500 (.SPX) posted its biggest weekly drop since June. But the benchmark index was only about 2% below its record high set this month. Other sectors, which lagged as tech shined last month, posted solid gains on the week, including healthcare and consumer staples. "This is very much an on-off switch type of market," Melson said. "When AI is working, it sucks all the oxygen out of the room for the rest of the sectors." META KICKS OFF HYPERSCALER RESULTS US reporting season heats up next week, with investors counting on robust performance. S&P 500 companies are expected to have increased earnings by more than 30% in the third quarter, according to LSEG IBES. Massive outlays on AI data centers and infrastructure underpin the profit jump. Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers that combined are expected to increase their capital spending to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs. Investors are eager for signs the companies can show returns on the investments, which would build confidence that the spending is sustainable. "One of the most important takeaways of earnings season is whether or not the profitability of the hyperscalers can grow faster than the pace of their capex," said Kevin Shea, senior equity analyst at BNY Wealth. Shares of Meta, whose market capitalization was about $1.8 trillion, have risen in recent weeks as it launched its Muse AI assistant "With the cost of capital going up, this capex blowout is going to become more expensive, which raises the bar for returns," said Chuck Carlson, chief executive officer at Horizon Investment Services. "Meta is going to be the first up to try to provide some color around that question." SEMIS, TESLA, NETFLIX ALSO ON TAP Chip companies have been among the biggest beneficiaries of the capital spending boom, but the stocks have cooled off. The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index (.SOX) has slumped about 12% this month, although it remained up 57% on the year, compared with a roughly 12% year-to-date gain for the S&P 500. Wednesday's reports from Lam Research and Texas Instruments could offer broader indications of demand in the semiconductor industry. Lam Research shares are up 54% in 2026, while Texas Instruments stock is up 59%. Elsewhere, investors will focus on results from Musk-run companies with market values well over $1 trillion: SpaceX — the newly public space company that also has an AI business — and Tesla, another signature stock of the tech-driven bull market. Streaming company Netflix (NFLX.O) , consumer products company Procter & Gamble (PG.N) and engine maker GE Aerospace (GE.N) are among other high-profile reports in the coming week. The rise in Treasury yields and prospects for further rate hikes from the Federal Reserve also remain front-burner issues for stock investors. Hot inflation data this week boosted bets on another rate increase at the Fed's meeting at the end of October. Futures pricing suggested most investors still expect the US central bank to wait until its meeting in December to raise rates for a second time this year. "Another strong earnings season should help equities withstand moderately higher rates," analysts at UBS Global Wealth Management said in a note on Thursday.

item.title: ＥＣＢ、年内に少なくともあと1回0.25％利上げ ＩＭＦ予想
item.description: [バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日公表した欧州経済の定期見通し報告書で、欧州中央銀行...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、年内に少なくともあと1回0.25％利上げ　ＩＭＦ予想 10/16 19:03 配信

IMFのロゴ。2024年11月にワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日公表した欧州経済の定期見通し報告書で、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が高インフレを抑えるため、年内に少なくともあと１回、２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施する可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

米国とイスラエルの対イラン攻撃を背景にエネルギー価格が急騰しインフレが加速したことを受けて、ＥＣＢは６月と９月にそれぞれ２５ｂｐの利上げを実施した。

ＩＭＦは「われわれの分析では、コアインフレを十分に抑制し続けるには、２０２６年中に少なくともあと１回、２５ｂｐの政策金利引き上げが必要になる」と指摘。「２６年より先の政策は今後のデータに応じて調整すべきだが、２８年にインフレ率を確実に目標へ回帰させるには、さらなる引き締めが必要になる可能性が高い」とした。

また「エネルギー価格上昇の影響を和らげるための財政支援は、慎重に設計しなければ、インフレ抑制の取り組みを損なう恐れがある」とも指摘した。

item.description: ［ロンドン １６日 ロイター］ - ＢｏｆＡグローバル・リサーチによると、投資家は１４日までの１週間に現金を減らし、債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
株・債券に資金流入、現金からシフト＝ＢｏｆＡ 10/16 18:45 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で8月撮影。 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［ロンドン　１６日　ロイター］ - ＢｏｆＡグローバル・リサーチによると、投資家は１４日までの１週間に現金を減らし、債券と株式に資金を投じた。

ＢｏｆＡがＥＰＦＲのデータを基にまとめた世界市場の週間資金フローは以下の通り。

・株式ファンドには６４５億ドル流入。

・ハイテク株に１０７億ドル流入した。年初来の流入額は過去最高の１９６０億ドル。米国株には３９１億ドル流入し、年初来では過去最高の６３６０億ドル。

・ハイテク株はここ数営業日、荒い値動きが続いており、ナスダック総合指数は１５日に１．８％下落した。同日、国債価格は急伸し、米１０年債利回りは１０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。ただ、国債はここ数カ月、売られ続けていた。

・債券には１１８億ドル流入。米国債には３６億ドルが流入し、１６週連続の流入。連続流入期間は２０２４年８月以来の長さ。米債券運用大手ＰＩＭＣＯのシニアアドバイザーは先週、売り込まれた米国債は「極めて割安」だと述べていた。

・「キャッシュ」と呼ばれるＭＭＦからは５３１億ドルが流出。

・新興国市場には１７７億ドルが流入。このうち中国が８６億ドルだった。

・ブラジルにはこの２週間で過去最高の４７億ドルが流入。１０月上旬に行われたブラジル大統領選の第１回投票では、右派のボルソナロ上院議員が予想を上回る得票。同氏は左派のルラ大統領と決選投票で争う。

item.title: UK clears Axel Springer takeover of Telegraph newspaper group
item.description: Britain's culture minister Lisa Nandy said on Friday she would not refer Axel Springer's planned purchase of the Telegraph Media Group to a more detailed competition investigation, clearing the way for the deal to proceed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's culture minister Lisa Nandy said on Friday she would not refer Axel Springer's [USN:L4N3ZU0XM TEXT:"planned purchase"] of the Telegraph Media Group to a more detailed competition investigation, clearing the way for the deal to proceed. Nandy said the Public Interest Intervention Notice, known as PIIN, issued in January 2024, along with the related public interest merger reference order, had ceased to be in force as a result of her decision. "I will not be referring this matter to a more in-depth 'Phase 2' investigation by the Competition and Markets Authority," she said in a written statement.

item.title: 経産省、台湾ＴＳＭＣの3ナノ半導体生産計画を認定 熊本第2工場
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は１６日、半導体受託生産の世界最大手、台湾積...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
経産省、台湾ＴＳＭＣの3ナノ半導体生産計画を認定　熊本第2工場 10/16 18:42 配信

ＴＳＭＣのロゴ。台北で7月撮影。 REUTERS/Ann Wang

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は１６日、半導体受託生産の世界最大手、台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が熊本県に建設中の第２工場で回路線幅３ナノメートル（ナノは１０億分の１）の先端半導体を生産するための計画変更を認定した。従来は６ナノや１２ナノ、４０ナノを計画していたが、変更後は３ナノに専念する。

現時点での生産枚数は月６０００枚を計画しているが、今後、日本政府の支援を前提に具体的数量を検討する。経産省は来年度予算で支援資金を要求中で、既に生産開始している第１工場を含む最大助成額は１兆円を超える見通し。

経産省の南部友成・情報産業課長は記者団に「これからのＡＩ（人工知能）トランスフォーメーションを考えれば、ＡＩ自体を支える３ナノの最先端ロジック半導体は必要不可欠だ」と指摘。国内に３ナノの生産拠点を確保することは「日本のサプライチェーン強靭化や経済安全保障の強化にとって非常に有意義だ」と述べた。

ＴＳＭＣの魏哲家最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２月、高市早苗首相と会談した際、第２工場で３ナノ半導体を生産する計画を伝えていた。同社は、今回の計画変更で熊本県の第１、第２工場への設備投資額が計２３０億ドル（約３兆６３００億円）を超える見込みとし「日本と世界中の顧客に先端技術を提供し、ＡＩ時代における強力な需要に対応していく」とコメントした。

item.title: 中国人民銀総裁、金融市場開放加速と人民元国際化推進表明
item.description: ［北京／上海 １６日 ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は、巨大な国内金融市場の一段の対外開放を進...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国人民銀総裁、金融市場開放加速と人民元国際化推進表明 10/16 18:40 配信

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁。2024年9月、北京で撮影。 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang

［北京／上海　１６日　ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は、巨大な国内金融市場の一段の対外開放を進める方針を示し、人民元建て資産は世界の投資家の間で高まる分散投資ニーズに応えることができると表明した。国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行総裁が開かれているタイのバンコクで１５日に行った講演内容を、人民銀行が発表した。

潘氏は講演で、地政学リスクの高まりや世界経済の構造的な変化、人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な進展に言及した。

「中国の着実な経済成長とハイテク産業の急速な発展は、人民元資産の確固たる支えとなる」と述べ、人民銀が投融資を促進するため、引き続きリスク管理ツールの拡充を進める方針を示した。

トランプ米大統領の関税措置や予測困難な外交政策によってドル資産の信認が損なわれる中、中国は資本市場の対外開放と人民元の国際化を推進する取り組みを強化している。

潘氏は、人民元建て債券が適格担保として世界的に受容され活用が拡大することを推進し、国境を越えた金融インフラの接続性を強化し、オフショア人民元市場の発展を支援すると表明した。

item.title: Israeli settlers burn olive trees, injure journalist in West Bank attack
item.description: Clad in black and their faces masked, dozens of militant Israeli settlers burned olive trees and threw rocks at Palestinians in a coordinated attack on Friday on a village's harvest in the Israeli-occupied West Bank that injured at least two people, including a journalist.
item.dc:creator: Pesha Magid, Ali Sawafta
item.content:encoded: Clad in black and their faces masked, dozens of militant Israeli settlers burned olive trees and threw rocks at Palestinians in a coordinated attack on Friday on a village's harvest in the Israeli-occupied West Bank that injured at least two people, including a journalist. Some 80 settlers, some of them carrying gas canisters, descended from a hill above a terraced olive grove where villagers from Abu Falah had gathered to pick ripe fruit, a cherished annual tradition in Palestinian life, Reuters witnesses said. The settlers took positions in front of the terraced lanes of olive trees. Some of them used slings to launch rocks towards Palestinian villagers, who descended towards the bottom of the hill before picking up and throwing stones to defend themselves. "The settlers want to attack us and force us from our homes," said Moutaz Abdelhadi, 42, a farmer who witnessed the attack in Abu Falah. Partway through the attack, at least two Israeli military jeeps sped through the area, kicking up dust as villagers ran out of their way. The attack continued after the military's arrival, with Israeli soldiers firing tear gas in the direction of the Palestinians who had dodged the jeeps. The sound of live gunfire could be heard in the area, and a Reuters photographer saw at least one armed settler fire a gun. In a statement, the Israeli military said soldiers and border police fired what it described as warning shots after deploying to the area and at one point fired towards a person who the troops believed had posed a threat. "Attempts to incite friction between populations undermine security in the area," the military said. "Attacks and violence against innocent civilians are grave and unacceptable," it added. WASHINGTON POST JOURNALIST INJURED Palestinian medics said two people were injured and taken to hospitals in the area of Ramallah. One of them was Heidi Levine, an American photojournalist with the Washington Post. Video of the attack showed Levine lying on her side on a dirt path with her hands over her face as at least three settlers surrounded her. Speaking from a hospital bed later, Levine, who is in stable condition, said: "I was attacked, pushed to the ground. Luckily I had my flak jacket and helmet, otherwise I probably wouldn't even be here, because they just kept kicking me and kicking me." Levine said the attack ended when her Palestinian colleagues intervened, after which medics rushed her in an ambulance to a clinic in Abu Falah and then to hospital in Ramallah. Her voice shook as she spoke, and she had bandages over her left hand. The Washington Post later reported she suffered lacerations across her body and a broken rib, and would need surgery on one hand after a finger was ripped open, exposing bone. In a statement, Matt Murray, the Washington Post's executive editor, called for an investigation into the incident. "This morning, a Washington Post photographer, Heidi Levine, was attacked by Israeli settlers while reporting in the West Bank,” Murray said. "She was wearing visible markings clearly identifying her as a journalist. While we are relieved that Heidi has received medical care and is safe, we are outraged by this unwarranted attack on a journalist doing her job and urge a thorough investigation and follow-through from authorities." The US State Department said it condemned criminal violence by any party in the West Bank and supported holding the perpetrators accountable. "The Department of State is aware of these reports. We are greatly concerned when any American is harmed overseas and stand ready to provide all appropriate consular assistance," a department spokesperson said. The department has reached out to the Washington Post to offer consular assistance, he added. SETTLER VIOLENCE HAS SURGED IN WEST BANK Israeli settler violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank has surged, with at least 170 attacks since September 27, around the start of the annual olive harvest, according to Yesh Din, an Israeli settlements monitoring group. The settlers have been emboldened by the right-wing government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has overseen a rapid expansion of settlements and smaller outposts across the West Bank. Netanyahu has criticized the violence but has taken few steps to crack down on incidents that have drawn international condemnation and sanction plans by longtime Israeli allies, including Britain. In a statement, Netanyahu’s office said the incident was under investigation. The West Bank is home to some 500,000 settlers and at least 3 million Palestinians. UN bodies and most countries deem the settlements illegal under international law regarding military occupations. Israel rejects this, viewing the territory as disputed rather than occupied. The Abu Falah attack followed a similar attack on Friday morning in the area of Turmus Ayya village, where settlers burned three cars after attacking a group of farmers harvesting olives. The military did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Salah Abu Niswa, who witnessed the attack in Turmus Ayya, said the settlers "snuck up like thieves, they caught someone by himself and began to beat him."

item.title: ニデック株を買い増し、保有比率は9％超に＝オアシスＣＩＯ
item.description:
Miho Uranaka
[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 香港のアクティビスト（物言う株主）ファンド、オアシス・マネジ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ニデック株を買い増し、保有比率は9％超に＝オアシスＣＩＯ 10/16 18:23 配信

都内のニデック事業所で９月撮影。

Miho Uranaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 香港のアクティビスト（物言う株主）ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントのセス・フィッシャー最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は１６日、都内で開催したチャリティイベントで、９％の株式保有を公表しているニデックについて、足元では保有比率がさらに高まっていることを明らかにした。その上で、条件次第では、保有比率を大幅に引き上げる可能性があるとの考えを示した。

フィッシャー氏は、「（昨日提出した）大量保有報告書では、同社株の保有比率は９％だが、現在はそれをやや上回っている。 大量保有報告書でも説明しているとおり、株価やその他の要因次第では保有比率を大幅に引き上げる可能性がある」と述べた。オアシスは１５日提出の報告書で、ニデック株について、５％超取得行為を予定していると明記していた。

数週間前に開かれたニデックの記者会見について「何をすべきかや、どのような措置を講じたのかについて十分な説明がなかった」と指摘。問題に直接関与した人物の処分や組織改革が遅れていることについて、「非常にがっかりしている」と語った。

同氏は、ニデックには取締役会レベルでの監督機能強化が必要との認識を示し、オアシスが取締役候補を提案しているという。会社側が迅速に対応しなければ、臨時株主総会（ＥＧＭ）の開催を求める可能性があると警告した。

さらに、ニデックは内部統制やコンプライアンス体制の整備を進める一方で、非公開化を含む戦略的な選択肢についても並行して検討すべきだと主張。「望まない形での上場廃止に追い込まれるリスクがある。それは株主や従業員にとって受け入れられない」と話した。

item.title: ＡＩ、安全策なければリスクが恩恵上回る恐れ＝ＩＭＦ専務理事
item.description:
Andrea Shalal Maria Martinez
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ、安全策なければリスクが恩恵上回る恐れ＝ＩＭＦ専務理事 10/16 18:21 配信

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事。バンコクで10月16日撮影。 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

Andrea Shalal　Maria Martinez

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）に適切な安全策や倫理的な枠組みを設けなければ、リスクが恩恵を上回る恐れがあると述べた。業界の自主規制に主要国政府の関与を組み合わせる考えを支持した。

米ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピック共同創業者のジャック・クラーク氏も参加したパネル討論で発言した。ＡＩは既に世界経済を押し上げているが、生産性の大幅な向上が期待されたほど早く実現しなければ、経済にマイナスのショックを及ぼす恐れもあると述べた。

「安全策がなければ、リスクが恩恵を上回るかもしれない。何よりも倫理的な基盤が必要だが、社会としてそこまで達しているかどうか、確信が持てない」と語った。

急速に進化するＡＩの恩恵を世界中の人々が受けるには、デジタルインフラや電力を利用できる環境、適切な規制といった一定の条件を整える必要があるとした。

また、これほど速く進化する技術にどう安全策を設けるかが、今やより大きな課題だと指摘。ＡＩの開発状況を、観客を守る防護柵がない中を猛スピードで走るＦ１マシンに例えた。

＜常識に即した基準＞

ゲオルギエワ氏は、絶えず変化するこの分野を規制・監督するのに政府は向いていないため、業界の自主規制が適切だと述べた。ただ社会との対話も必要だとした。米国、中国、インドなどＡＩ産業の規模が大きい国々に加え、ＡＩのサプライチェーン（供給網）に関わる国々も関与すべきだと語った。

ＩＭＦのような機関も、生産性の伸び、労働市場、金融安定へのリスクなど、それぞれの専門分野で関与すべきだと述べた。

クラーク氏は基準づくりは可能であり、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の初期段階の政策枠組みや米国での自主的な取り組みを通じ、既に始まりつつあると主張した。

同氏はアンソロピックが自社システムを定期的に試験し、試験の詳細を公表して情報を共有していると説明した。ただ、こうした取り組みを完全に自主性に委ねるべきではないとの考えを示した。

ＡＩを開発する国々による規制に賛成するかと問われると、「賛成だ。常識に即した基準が必要だ。それが最終的に技術への信頼を生み、経済を発展させる」と答えた。

また、アンソロピックは第三者の評価者を受け入れ、データを調べる権限を与えていると説明した。「最終的には、他の多くの企業もそうする必要があると考えている」と述べ、イーロン・マスク氏が自身の会社スペースＸも同様の取り組みを行う可能性に言及したことを歓迎した。

ブラウン米財務次官（国際担当）は別の記者会見で、ＩＭＦは世界経済のリスクに目を向け過ぎており、ＡＩのように経済にプラスのショックをもたらす可能性をもっと重視すべきだと述べた。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）の会合で、ＡＩの試験基準を巡って各国の足並みがそろうことについて、１カ月前より楽観的になったと述べた。

別のパネル討論で、ドイツ連邦銀行（中銀）のナーゲル総裁が、ＡＩは世界の不均衡を拡大させる可能性があると述べた。「ハードウエアとソフトウエア開発の両面でＡＩに巨額の投資が必要なことを考えれば、それは明らかだ」と語った。

ハーバード大学の経済学者ダニ・ロドリック氏は、ＡＩによる生産性向上が実現するかどうかは分からず、もろ刃の剣になっていると指摘した。先週、ベルリンで開かれた学際的な会議の後、ロイターに語った。

生産性が向上すれば、影響を受ける業種で大規模な雇用喪失が起き、職を追われる人が出る可能性がある。一方、向上しなければ、データセンターへの巨額投資が多大な損失を伴う金融面の調整を引き起こしかねないと述べた。「雇用危機か金融危機か、どちらに対処することになるのか分からない」と語った。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝反発、ＡＩ企業の自社株買い好感 当局の支援観測
item.description: [１６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が相次いで自社株買いや好調な業績見通しを発表した...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝反発、ＡＩ企業の自社株買い好感　当局の支援観測 10/16 18:14 配信

3月、上海で撮影。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura

[１６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が相次いで自社株買いや好調な業績見通しを発表したことが支えとなった。ただ、週間では３カ月ぶりの大幅な下げとなった。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％高で終了。上海総合指数は０．２％高。ただ、ＣＳＩ３００指数は週間では３．４％下落し、７月中旬以来の大幅な下げ。１０週連続の下落となった。

ハイテク株は下げ止まった。光トランシーバーメーカーの蘇州旭創科技（イオプトリンク）や半導体製造装置メーカーの北京屹唐半導体科技（パイオテック）など、少なくとも１０社のＡＩサプライチェーン関連企業が自社株買いや株式取得計画を発表した。

また半導体メーカーの沐曦集成電路（メタエックス）などハイテク企業が相次いで、高成長を示す第３・四半期の業績予想を発表した。

取引終盤には、「国家隊」と呼ばれる政府系投資家が選好する複数の上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の商いが急増。政府が株式市場支援に動いたとの観測が広がった。

さらにブルームバーグ・ニュースは、規制当局が企業や政府系ファンドに株式購入を促し、一部の投資家に売却を控えるよう指導していると報じた。

不動産と防衛関連株も３％超上昇した。

香港市場ではバイオテクノロジー株と不動産株が急伸した。

item.title: 中国、ＡＩなど40技術で輸出規制案 対象外設定で企業に海外展開余地
item.description:
Eduardo Baptista
［北京 １６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Eduardo Baptista

［北京　１６日　ロイター］ - 中国商務省は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル、ＡＩエージェント、計算クラスターに関わる技術など、ＡＩ分野の２３技術を対象とする輸出規制案を発表した。最先端技術の開発を巡り米国との競争が激しくなるなか、不可欠と見なす技術の移転を制限する最新の動きとなる。

改定案は、ＡＩのほかバイオ医薬、太陽光発電の分野など４０の技術を対象としている。１１月１５日まで一般から意見を募る。同時に、対象となる技術には暫定措置として輸出前の登録制度を導入する。

商務省は今回の改定について、機微な分野で関連技術の応用が広がり続けていることを理由に挙げた。また特定の国や地域、組織を狙い撃ちした措置ではないと説明した。

改定案では、制限対象技術を含むＡＩモデルの海外展開を対象とする一方、アプリケーション・プログラミング・インターフェース（ＡＰＩ）、ウェブサイト、アプリ、サービスとしてのソフトウエア（ＳａａＳ）プラットフォーム経由でのアクセスは対象外とする。

この区分けにより、ディープシークやアリババといった中国のＡＩ開発企業による海外展開の余地が残される一方、中国政府は機微なＡＩ技術の海外移転に対する監督を強められる見通し。

ディープシークの「Ｒ１」モデルが２０２５年に登場して以降、中国製ＡＩモデルは低価格と性能改善を背景に海外で存在感を高めている。ＡＩ分野の管理をどこまで厳格化するかを決める上で、中国政府にとって重みを増している。

ロイターは７月、中国当局がアリババ、バイトダンスなど主要テクノロジー企業と、未公開のものを含む中国の最先端人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルへの海外からのアクセスを制限する可能性について協議したと報じていた。

商務省は１６日、悪意あるソフトウエアを自律的に生成・改変できるシステムなどＡＩ技術の悪用防止も規制の目的と説明。大半のＡＩ技術は引き続き自由に輸出できるとし、オープンソース技術の輸出や中国企業が自社で運営する海外のコンピューティングセンターは簡素化した許可手続きを適用する。オープンソースでの公開や学術論文ですでに知られている技術は規制案の対象外になる。

改定案には、一部の新規細胞・遺伝子治療と低分子干渉ＲＮＡ（ｓｉＲＮＡ）技術に関する知的財産権の移転を禁じる内容も盛り込まれている。

item.title: 情報ＢＯＸ：インドネシア「スタンドアローン」に格下げも、ＭＳＣＩの市場分類とは
item.description: ［ジャカルタ １６日 ロイター］ - 指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１６日、インドネシア株式市場を「エマージング（新興国）市場」...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
情報ＢＯＸ：インドネシア「スタンドアローン」に格下げも、ＭＳＣＩの市場分類とは 10/16 17:43 配信

ジャカルタで2月撮影。REUTERS/Willy Kurniawan

［ジャカルタ　１６日　ロイター］ - 指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１６日、インドネシア株式市場を「エマージング（新興国）市場」から「スタンドアローン」に格下げすることを検討していると発表した。以前警告していた「フロンティア市場」への格下げよりも厳しいもので、株や通貨ルピアは急落した。

ＭＳＣＩは、経済発展の水準、市場の規模と流動性、投資家に対する開放度に基づき、指数を４つのカテゴリーに分類している。概要は以下の通り。

＜先進国市場＞

最も成熟し、アクセスしやすい株式市場が対象。海外投資家の参加が事実上制限されておらず、資本の流れが非常に大きく、効率的な取引システムと安定した規制の枠組みを備える。この分類に入るには、１人当たり国民総所得（ＧＮＩ）が３年連続で世界銀行の高所得国基準を２５％上回る必要がある。

米国、日本、シンガポールがこの分類に含まれる。

＜新興国市場＞

経済発展に関する要件はないが、この区分に入るのは通常、新興国経済と見なされる国だ。「新興国市場」は、海外投資家に対する開放度が高く、資本移動も容易だが、「先進国市場」と比べるとなお一定の制約がある市場が対象となる。また、十分に機能し実績のある取引運営の枠組みを備えていることなども求められる。

ブラジル、中国、インド、韓国などが含まれる。インドネシアもその一つだが、同国の指数ウエートは２０２６年初めの１．１６％から９月末には０．４％に低下した。

＜フロンティア市場＞

比較的規模が小さく、発展が遅れている、あるいはアクセスしにくい市場が対象。ＭＳＣＩの組み入れ要件を満たす企業が１社あればよく、外国人投資家にある程度開放され、資本の出入りが少なくとも部分的に可能で、取引がそれなりに効率的であり、安定した制度的枠組みを備えていることが求められる。この分類には「アドバンスト・フロンティア市場」という下位区分がある。これは投資家にとってのアクセス性は高いものの、規模と流動性が限られる市場だ。

フロンティア市場にはベトナム、パキスタン、モロッコなどが含まれる。アドバンスト・フロンティア市場にはラトビアやエストニアといった欧州諸国が含まれる。

＜スタンドアローン市場＞

「スタンドアローン市場」指数は、対象市場を「新興国」や「フロンティア」の指数には組み入れないが、規模と流動性についてはそれらの基準を用いる。市場へのアクセス性や規模、流動性が著しく悪化した場合、「スタンドアローン市場」に再分類されることがある。新たに適格となった市場もこの分類に入る。

アルゼンチン、パナマ、ウクライナなどが「スタンドアローン」に分類されている。インドネシアがこの分類に移れば、経済規模で同グループ最大となり、２番目に大きいアルゼンチンの２倍以上となる。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：北朝鮮が韓国と対立姿勢、米国にとって新たな悩みの種に 焦点：新興国投資ラッシュに取り残されるインドネシア、強い政策への不信感 アングル：スマトラ島豪雨被害、森林破壊で被害拡大か　地元に怒りの声 アングル：石炭依存の東南アジア、長期電力購入契約がエネ移行の妨げに 最終更新: 10/16(金) 17:49 ロイター

item.title: マン・グループ、運用資産が過去最高の2709億ドル
item.description: [ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 大手ヘッジファンドのマン・グループが１６日発表した９月末の運用資産残高は、過去最...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マン・グループ、運用資産が過去最高の2709億ドル 10/16 17:30 配信

[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 大手ヘッジファンドのマン・グループが１６日発表した９月末の運用資産残高は、過去最高の２７０９億ドルとなった。６月末比では６．８％増えた。市場の変動が激しくなる中で資金流入が進んだ。発表後、株価は３％上昇した。

シティによると、運用資産残高は前年同期比２６％増加し、市場予想の２６３０億ドルを上回った。

第３・四半期の資金流入額は１０１億ドルと、予想を上回った。このうちオルタナティブファンドへの流入が１９億ドル、買い持ち戦略のファンド（ロング・オンリー・ファンド）への流入が８２億ドルだった。

運用資産残高の増加額のうち、５９億ドルは運用益によるものだった。

シティは今回の結果を好調と評価した。「市場の変動が激しさを増し、流動性の高いオルタナティブ投資に対する投資家の需要が拡大する中、マン・グループは特に恩恵を受ける企業の一つとみている」と述べた。

item.title: Tesla's new Roadster turns in air with SpaceX thrusters, won't land until 2028
item.description: Powered by rocket-style thrusters, Tesla's new Roadster raced upside down along a ramp, launched into a mid-air flip and landed back on its wheels.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Tesla's new Roadster turns in air with SpaceX thrusters, won't land until 2028

Powered by rocket-style thrusters, Tesla's new Roadster raced upside down along a ramp, launched into a mid-air flip and landed back on its wheels.

Tesla unveils its long-delayed Roadster nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original electric sports car, at a launch event in Waco, Texas, US, on Oct 15, 2026, in this still image taken from a handout video. (Image: Tesla/Handout via Reuters)

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO: Tesla unveiled a redesigned Roadster powered with rocket-style thrusters on Thursday (Oct 15) and said it would start production in 2028, more than a decade after it first showed a next-generation version of its electric sports car. The white two-seater vehicle, developed in collaboration with CEO Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX, drove upside down on a ramp using a suction system, turned in the air and landed using built-in thrusters. Later in the event it used the thrusters to jump over a truck and other vehicles, twisting in the air during the maneuver. Some watchers saw the collaboration as Musk drumming up interest in a merger of the two big companies he controls, an idea he has explored by discussing their overlap.

The reveal gives Tesla a showpiece car after years of missed Roadster deadlines, but it comes as the company shifts its focus to self-driving technology and robotics, and days before third-quarter results that analysts say matter more to investors. "It was an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers," Gene Munster, managing partner at Tesla investor Deepwater Asset Management, said on social media platform X. "The Roadster event is the latest example of why Elon can't wait to bring (Tesla) and (SpaceX) together," Munster said. Musk has played down the car's importance to Tesla's finances, describing it in 2023 as a "small potato situation" that would not "move the needle in a major way financially". But the car still carries symbolic weight.

"Tesla does not currently have a halo car, or high-performance luxury vehicle designed to showcase an automaker's best engineering and technology. The Roadster will be Tesla's new halo car," Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said in a note last month. Viewers and witnesses gushed over the spectacle of the launch. "That was the most insane product demo I've ever seen," Tesla fan and investor Sawyer Merritt posted on X. "I just saw this in person, and I'm still asking how this wasn't AI." Musk and other executives did not specify any target prices at Thursday's event, although Tesla nearly a decade ago quoted a base price of US$200,000 for the vehicle. Tesla's reservation page for the Roadster after Thursday's event showed a "Performance" version of the vehicle requiring a US$50,000 deposit and a "Thrust" version with "acceleration thrusters" requiring a US$250,000 deposit. A "Rocket" variant, which Tesla says is "invite only", is described as a single-seat model with a "full flight system". "HALFWAY TO THE SPEED OF SOUND" The event at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, had all the elements of a classic Musk product reveal: Dramatic music, smoke, mechanical hissing sounds and a launch countdown. "This is the culmination of incredible work by Tesla and SpaceX engineers working closely together to make something that you haven't seen in any movie," Musk, wearing a silver Western-style belt buckle emblazoned with the Tesla logo, told a cheering crowd of enthusiasts and investors. The Roadster can accelerate from zero to 97 kmh in less than one second and can hit a top speed of over 370 kmh, Tesla vehicle engineering chief Lars Moravy said.

Tesla unveils its long-delayed Roadster nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original electric sports car, at a launch event in Waco, Texas, US, on Oct 15, 2026, in this still image taken from a handout video. (Image: Tesla/Handout via Reuters)

Tesla unveils its long-delayed Roadster nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original electric sports car, at a launch event in Waco, Texas, US, on Oct 15, 2026, in this still image taken from a handout video. (Image: Tesla/Handout via Reuters)

"Definitely much faster than that," an excited Musk said. "I think you've got to crack halfway to the speed of sound." The Roadster can also travel over 480km on a single charge. That is less than half of what Musk promised in 2017, when Tesla first revealed a prototype of the second-generation Roadster and said that deliveries would begin in 2020. The original Roadster, released in 2008 and on sale until 2012, was Tesla's first-ever electric vehicle and used a Lotus Elise chassis. It helped change the world's view of what an EV could be. The company has since been known for its Model Y and Model X SUVs and Model S and Model 3 sedans. The reveal of the second-generation Roadster comes amid a sharp shift in Tesla's focus to artificial intelligence-led self-driving tech and robotics, from manufacturing cars for human drivers. This year, Tesla stopped selling Model S and X vehicles to make space for production of its Optimus humanoid robots. It also launched Cybercab - a two-seater robotaxi that comes without manual controls such as a steering wheel, pedals and mirrors. Tesla is set to report third-quarter results on Oct 21. Sales of Tesla's aging lineup of EVs have declined over the past two years, although high gas prices helped boost deliveries in the third quarter. "The margin and cash flow numbers will carry far more weight with investors than anything they saw at the reveal," said Josh Gilbert, lead analyst for Asia-Pacific at trading platform eToro.

Source: Reuters/lk
